title: Venue price
description: What this venue is paying for Up on its own BTC market, in cents on the dollar. Its strike and clock differ from ours, so compare with care.

affirmative_bid.label: Up bid
affirmative_bid.description: The highest price a buyer is waiting at for the Up contract on this venue. Selling Up there fills here.

affirmative_ask.label: Up ask
affirmative_ask.description: The lowest price a seller is waiting at for the Up contract on this venue. Buying Up there fills here.

affirmative_midpoint.label: Up midpoint
affirmative_midpoint.description: Halfway between the venue's Up bid and ask, its fair odds that BTC finishes above its strike. Fifty cents is a coin flip.

last_trade_price.label: Last trade
last_trade_price.description: The price of the most recent fill on this venue. It lags the book when nobody is trading.
